about.metaTitle: About us — Mebo | Custom kitchens and furniture from IJmuiden
about.metaDescription: Get to know Mebo: a workshop in IJmuiden where custom kitchens and furniture are designed, produced and installed by one team.
about.title: One workshop, one team, work to be proud of.
about.intro: Mebo is a workshop in IJmuiden where design, production and installation happen under one roof. Every kitchen and every piece of furniture is made to measure — for real homes and the people who live in them.
about.heroImageAlt: The Mebo workshop in IJmuiden with custom furniture in production
about.p1: Mebo started as a small furniture workshop in IJmuiden. What began with a single workbench and a handful of tools has grown into a modern workshop with its own machinery and a dedicated team.
about.p2: Today we design, produce and install custom kitchens and furniture throughout the Netherlands. The mindset of that first workbench never left: take the time to do it right, measure twice, and never deliver anything we wouldn't put in our own homes.
about.p3: Behind every project is a small team of designers, makers and installers. One point of contact, from the first sketch to the final screw.
about.imageAlt1: Design consultation in the Mebo showroom
about.imageAlt2: CNC production in the Mebo workshop

privacy.metaTitle: Privacy statement — Mebo | Custom kitchens and furniture
privacy.metaDescription: How Mebo Keukens handles your personal data: what we process, why, how long we keep it and the rights you have.
privacy.title: Privacy statement
intro: Mebo Keukens (Mebo CNS v.o.f.), located at Plein 1945 50, 1971 GC IJmuiden, the Netherlands, and registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce under number 91028248, is responsible for the processing of personal data as described in this privacy statement.
We handle your data with care: we only process what is needed to handle your request, and we never sell your data. Questions? Email us at info@mebokeukens.nl.

sections.heading: What data we process
paragraphs: We only process data you provide to us yourself, or that is needed to keep the website running:
list: Appointment form: your name, phone number, email address (optional), your preferred date and time, and what you tell us about your project, such as the project type and an indicative budget.
Direct contact: if you call, email or message us, we process the details you share with us.

Technical data: our hosting provider briefly processes IP addresses in server logs to keep the website secure and available, and compiles anonymous visitor statistics (visitor and page-view counts, without cookies and without individual profiles).
Advertising cookies: only if you accept them via the cookie banner — see the cookie statement.

sections.heading: What we use your data for
paragraphs: We use your data only for the following purposes:
list: To answer your request and prepare an appointment or quote (necessary to take steps at your request prior to entering into a contract, art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
To keep the website secure and available (legitimate interest, art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
To measure and show our ads on social media — only with your consent via the cookie banner (art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw that consent at any time.

sections.heading: How long we keep your data
paragraphs: We keep your data no longer than necessary. Requests and quote correspondence are kept for up to two years after our last contact, so we can help you properly with a follow-up question. If you become a customer, we keep invoices and records for seven years, as required by Dutch tax law.

sections.heading: Who we share your data with
paragraphs: We never sell your data. We only share it with service providers (processors) needed to run the website and our mailbox:
list: Resend — delivery of the appointment form to our mailbox.
after: If you accept advertising cookies, the ad platforms Meta, TikTok, Google and Pinterest also receive data about your visit. The cookie statement explains which cookies these are and how to change your choice.

sections.heading: Transfers outside the EEA
paragraphs: Some of these providers process data in the United States. This happens on the basis of the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and/or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Your rights
list: see which data we hold about you;
have processing restricted, or object to it;
receive your data in a portable format (data portability);
withdraw consent you have given at any time, for example via the cookie settings at the bottom of the page.
after: Send your request to info@mebokeukens.nl; we respond within one month. If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, you can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this privacy statement, for example when we start using new services. The current version is always on this page, with the date of the latest change at the top.

cookiesPage.title: Cookie statement
intro: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. This page explains which cookies www.mebokeukens.nl uses and why.

Functional cookies are always set: the website does not work properly without them. Advertising cookies are only set after you accept them via the cookie banner. You can change your choice at any time via 'Cookie settings' at the bottom of the page.

functional.heading: Functional cookies (always active)
functional.intro: These cookies are needed to make the website work properly. Under Dutch law, no consent is required for this type of cookie.

rows.name: NEXT_LOCALE
rows.purpose: Remembers your language choice (Dutch or English) after you switch languages.

rows.name: mebo-consent
rows.purpose: Remembers your cookie choice, so we don't ask again on every visit.

marketing.heading: Advertising cookies (only with your consent)
marketing.intro: These cookies let ad platforms measure whether our ads work — for example when someone sees an ad on Instagram and then books an appointment through the website — and show our ads to people who are likely to be interested. They are only set after you click 'Accept', and only during periods in which we advertise.

rows.name: _fbp
rows.purpose: Measures the reach and effect of our ads on Facebook and Instagram.

rows.name: _ttp
rows.purpose: Measures the reach and effect of our ads on TikTok.

rows.name: _gcl_au
rows.purpose: Measures conversions from our ads via Google Ads and YouTube.

rows.name: _pin_unauth
rows.purpose: Measures the reach and effect of our ads on Pinterest.

marketing.thirdParty: These platforms are themselves responsible for what they do with this data. Read their own privacy policies:

manage.heading: Changing or withdrawing your choice
body: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time via 'Cookie settings' at the bottom of every page. If you withdraw consent, we remove the advertising cookies set through this website.
You can also always delete or block cookies yourself in your browser settings.
